children: Raman Singh, a Director, reported selling common stock in two transactions on September 11 and September 14, 2026. The weighted average price on September 11 was $68.6181 and the September 14 sale price was $66.16. The total proceeds from the sales were $1,179,452. Following the reported transactions, the reporting person directly owns 44,637 shares of common stock, which includes 5,882 unvested restricted stock units.
